_comment: SIGNAL 45 canonical stock-resource values (vertical slice). PROVISIONAL until first-playable measurement (D-043). Single source of truth: docs cite this file; survival_model.py loads it.

spoilage.rule: forecast-only in slice: perishables from runs must be eaten within 2 days or convert to 50% stable rations; no silent loss

contamination.effect: tank flagged: boil order (+2 charge/day) or medicine risk; supply link named in warning

medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.rules: consumed when treatment begins (committed at triage); never passively lost; no expiration in slice

materials.name: Materials
materials.note: labor model (simulate_vertical_slice.py) owns the authoritative materials ledger; survival model mirrors it
materials.reservation: reserved at project confirmation; consumed at completed stages; unconsumed reserve refunds 100%; deconstruction recovers 50% of consumed materials, once per installed component (no loops)

charge.name: Charge
charge.note: the Fuel role of the canonical set (D-043): stored energy powering defined equipment; the Flywheel is the producer, the load board names every consumer

item_families._comment: Layer 3 architecture. Detailed recipes are the crafting stage's work; the HUD 'Materials' chip expands to show family availability per project.
item_families.project_block_rule: a blocked project names the missing family, never just 'not enough Materials'

needs.scale: 0-100; hunger/fatigue/stress higher is worse; health higher is better
needs.death_rule: slice: no death; critical health auto-pauses and forces the emergency card; full game: death requires an existing serious condition + warning + response window + a deliberate high-risk choice
